description: The file 'delta_advanced.lua' is an example script demonstrating usage of Delta API functions related to points, Modbus communication, socket networking, utility functions, and cooperative multitasking. It contains function calls, object creations, and example procedures but no function definitions or class implementations, indicating it functions as a usage example or script rather than a standalone module.

classes.name: SocketClass
classes.description: A class representing a socket client connection, providing methods for sending, receiving, checking status, and closing the socket.

classes.name: SocketServer
classes.description: A class for creating and managing a socket server listening on a specified port.

methods.name: SocketVersion
methods.description: A function to get or print the current socket API version.

methods.name: CheckAllStatus
methods.description: A function that checks the status of all managed socket connections.

methods.name: split
methods.description: A utility function to split strings by a delimiter.

methods.name: AuxTasksAdd
methods.description: Function to register multiple subfunctions for cooperative multitasking.

methods.name: AuxTasks
methods.description: Function to execute registered auxiliary tasks in a cooperative manner.
